metaDescription: Order custom 5 oz wine glasses for tastings or events. Perfect for samples. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Five-ounce wine glasses are the ideal size for wine tastings, sample pours, and events where guests want to sample multiple varieties without committing to a full glass. These compact glasses are also popular for dessert wines, port, or cordials. Choose from stemless designs for easy handling or classic stems for a formal touch. Add your logo or event name with screen printing or etching to create a memorable takeaway for your next tasting or corporate gathering.
heroAltText: Custom 5 oz wine glasses with logo for tastings and events
